title: Opening
body:
<<img, "samples/visual-novel-city-map/assets/images/office_interior_nophone.png">>
<<character, show, detective, x = 280, xScale = -1>>
<<character, show, secretary, x = 680>>
<<speaker, Secretary>>
You're late. Again.
<<speaker, Detective>>
The city kept me up.
<<speaker, Secretary>>
The city doesn't pay rent. The landlord came by twice.
<<speaker, Detective>>
How much do we have?
<<speaker, Secretary>>
Enough for the phone bill or the light bill. Pick one.
<<speaker, Detective>>
Keep the phone. I can work in the dark.
<<speaker, Secretary>>
Good. Because the phone rang at eight. Vivian Ash.
<<speaker, Detective>>
The Vivian Ash? Hill money?
<<speaker, Secretary>>
Someone stole her gem last night. The Crimson Heart. She wants us on it today.
<<speaker, Detective>>
Why us?
<<speaker, Secretary>>
She asked for someone discreet. I think she meant cheap.
Briggs called too. He's arresting somebody at nine tonight whether you help or not.
<<speaker, Detective>>
Then I have until nine.
<<speaker, Secretary>>
Twelve hours. Don't spend them all at Mae's.

title: Office
body:
<<img, "samples/visual-novel-city-map/assets/images/office_interior_nophone.png">>
<<character, show, detective, x = 280, xScale = -1>>
<<character, show, secretary, x = 680>>
<<talk>>
<<speaker, Secretary>>
<<if $knowsDebt == false>>
I read the society pages so you don't have to. The bank is selling the Ash house next month.
<<set $knowsDebt = true>>
<<elseif $knowsPawn == false>>
You know what I know. Go find out something I don't.
<<else>>
A pawn ticket in her own name? Then she wasn't robbed. She's broke.
<<end>>
<<if $band == "evening">>
It's getting late. Whatever you have, Briggs gets it at nine.
<<end>>

title: Street
body:
<<img, "samples/visual-novel-city-map/assets/images/office_exterior.png">>
<<character, show, detective, x = 280, xScale = -1>>
<<if $band == "evening">>
<<speaker>>
The street is empty. A card is stuck in the door frame: "Back tomorrow. Probably."
<<else>>
<<character, show, jimmy, x = 680>>
<<talk>>
<<speaker, Jimmy>>
<<if $knowsPawn == true>>
If anyone asks, I was a concerned citizen. Very concerned. Extremely a citizen.
<<elseif $knowsMeeting == true>>
Mae talks a lot for a woman who says so little. Fine. Kessler Loans. Ticket 4471. She told me it was a short loan.
<<set $knowsPawn = true>>
<<else>>
Last night? Home. Alone. Reading law books. Big ones. Have a card.
<<end>>
<<end>>

title: Bar
body:
<<img, "samples/visual-novel-city-map/assets/images/bar.png">>
<<character, show, detective, x = 280, xScale = -1>>
<<if $band == "morning">>
<<speaker>>
The door is locked.
<<speaker, Mae>>
We open at noon. Come back thirsty.
<<else>>
<<character, show, mae, x = 680>>
<<talk>>
<<speaker, Mae>>
<<if $band == "evening">>
Briggs's men were in here an hour ago asking about Jimmy. I didn't charge them. I didn't tell them anything either.
<<end>>
<<if $knowsPawn == true>>
Kessler sells what people forget to pick up. Don't let her forget.
<<elseif $knowsMeeting == true>>
You bought that already. I don't sell twice.
<<else>>
Ten bucks and I remember last night.
Vivian Ash. Here at nine. She slid Jimmy a velvet box under the table. She was never at the opera.
<<set $knowsMeeting = true>>
<<end>>
<<end>>

title: Precinct
body:
<<img, "samples/visual-novel-city-map/assets/images/precinct.png">>
<<character, show, detective, x = 280, xScale = -1>>
<<character, show, commissioner, x = 680>>
<<talk>>
<<speaker, "Commissioner Briggs">>
<<if $band == "evening">>
I've got my coat on. Talk fast.
<<end>>
<<if $knowsPawn == true>>
A pawn ticket in her name? I'll send a man to Dock Street. If you're wrong I'll take your licence.
<<else>>
The lawyer's card was on her hall table. That's a case. Nine tonight I pick him up.
<<end>>

title: Ending
body:
<<img, "samples/visual-novel-city-map/assets/images/office_interior_nophone.png">>
<<character, show, detective, x = 280, xScale = -1>>
<<character, show, secretary, x = 680>>
<<speaker, Detective>>
<<if $knowsPawn == true and $knowsDebt == true>>
Kessler opened his safe at half past eight. The Crimson Heart was in it. Mrs. Ash had a bank notice and a plan. Now she has a lawyer. Not Jimmy.
<<elseif $knowsPawn == true>>
The gem turned up at Kessler's. She says a thief pawned it in her name. Without a motive Briggs believes her. At least Jimmy sleeps at home.
<<else>>
Briggs picked up Jimmy at nine sharp. The papers got their headline. Somewhere on Dock Street a red stone sits in a safe and waits.
<<end>>
